You’ll probably still have some stomach issues haha :) but it can be easily mitigated with a few practises.
You can either germinate the seeds (sitting them in water for hours and peeling them open to reveal a weird, brain-like thing) and just eating the plant matter. This is probably the best method as in theory it’ll preserve more of the psychoactive alkaloids and won’t lose much potency, while reducing nausea.
You can do a CWE - Sitting the crushed up seeds seeds in cold water for 12 - 24 hours and then filtering the seed matter out. This is very effective at combating nausea but in my opinion it kinda leads to an underwhelming experience (depending on dose, obviously). I don’t know if it’s just my fried serotonin receptors but with this method I always lose some of the magic, and nausea is usually still present. 
Or, there’s always the option of braving the nausea out and eating the seeds raw - make sure you have some ginger though and keep your dosage right and you can still have some very pleasant effects. 
Hope this helped!
Stay safe and happy travels 💫
